text: Erengrad is Kislev's gateway to the sea. As the second-largest and most important trading hub in the Old World, Erengrad's harbor district draws in curiosities from every corner of the globe, including all manner of weapons potent enough to crush any foe.

Praag is a city of contradictions, steeped in both Chaos corruption and noble faith. Whatever else it may be, Praag remains part of Kislev, and these ascetics who carry the blood of the Bear God in their veins will cleanse the sins that blanket the city with blood and fire.

The Ursun's Teeth are Kislev's champion warriors, most often seen serving as the Boyar's palace guard. To the outside world, they are seen as a symbol of Ursun's power and the finest expression of Kislev's might.
